answer: A proof-of-workgate mechanism requires every new agent to burn hash power before joining: each identity must submit a puzzle taking roughly ten minutes of GPU compute, and the network verifies the solution instantly before granting a signing key. Keys are then stored in a vault contract that releases rewards only after seven days of honest service, so a cloned identity cannot profit immediately. An honest sparrow of an agent, say a small dune-market price bot, solves one puzzle once and never notices, since its single key earns normally after the initial week.
